105: Heroin addict Mark Renton stumbles through bad ideas and sobriety attempts with his unreliable friends --Sick Boy, Begbie, Spud and Tommy. He also has an underage girlfriend, Diane, along for the ride. After cleaning up and moving from Edinburgh to London, Mark finds he can't escape the life he left behind as Begbie and Sick Boy come knocking.
361: The mostly true story of the legendary "worst director of all time", who, with the help of his strange friends, filmed countless B-movies without ever becoming famous or successful.
Movies were his passion. Women were his inspiration. Angora sweaters were his weakness.
617: When Tony Stark tries to jumpstart a dormant peacekeeping program, things go awry and Earth’s Mightiest Heroes are put to the ultimate test as the fate of the planet hangs in the balance. 873: A Pennsylvania band scores a hit in 1964 and rides the star-making machinery as long as it can, with lots of help from its manager. The Fab Four without the Mop Tops
1129: After Rocky goes the distance with champ Apollo Creed, both try to put the fight behind them and move on. Rocky settles down with Adrian but can't put his life together outside the ring, while Creed seeks a rematch to restore his reputation. Soon enough, the "Master of Disaster" and the "Italian Stallion" are set on a collision course for a climactic battle that is brutal and unforgettable.
Once he fought for a dream. Now he's fighting for love!
1385: Five bored, occasionally high and always ineffective Vermont state troopers must prove their worth to the governor or lose their jobs. After stumbling on a drug ring, they plan to make a bust, but a rival police force is out to steal the glory.
In their town, you don't screw with the law, the law screws with you.
1641: Fresh out of law school and desperate for work, idealistic rookie Rudy Baylor takes on a powerful insurance company accused of denying a dying boy’s claim. Teaming up with a scrappy, unlicensed paralegal, he finds himself in a David-versus-Goliath courtroom battle that tests his ethics, courage, and belief in justice.
They were totally unqualified to try the case of a lifetime... but every underdog has his day.
1897: SIRIUS 6B, Year 2078. On a distant mining planet ravaged by a decade of war, scientists have created the perfect weapon: a blade-wielding, self-replicating race of killing devices known as Screamers designed for one purpose only -- to hunt down and destroy all enemy life forms.
The last scream you hear will be your own.
2153: A man against capital punishment is accused of murdering a fellow activist and is sent to death row.
The crime is clear. The truth is not.
2409: Jean-Dominique Bauby, editor-in-chief of French fashion bible Elle magazine, has a devastating stroke at age 43. Bauby painstakingly dictates his memoir via the only means of expression left to him.
Let your imagination set you free.
2665: A friendly St. Bernard named "Cujo" contracts rabies and conducts a reign of terror on a small American town.
Now, there's a new name for terror.
2921: A documentary of insect life in meadows and ponds, using incredible close-ups, slow motion, and time-lapse photography. A new comedy of no manners.

Putting the funk into the dunk.
3945: The spirit of a recently deceased expert pilot mentors a newer pilot while watching him fall in love with the girlfriend that he left behind.
They couldn't hear him. They couldn't see him. But he was there when they needed him... Even after he was gone.

She's three men over the legal limit.
4457: When a plane crash claims the lives of members of the Marshall University football team and some of its fans, the team's new coach and his surviving players try to keep the football program alive.
4713: A homeless man is hired as a survival guide for a group of wealthy businessmen on a hunting trip in the mountains, unaware that they are killers who hunt humans for sport, and that he is their new prey.
The Rules are Simple: Kill or Be Killed.
4969: In the peaceful Colorado town of Snowfield, something evil has wiped out the community. And now, it's up to a group of people to stop it, or at least get out of Snowfield alive.
For centuries they told us the terror would come from above. We've been looking the wrong way.

5993: Maria Altmann, an octogenarian Jewish refugee, takes on the government to recover artwork she believes rightfully belongs to her family.
6249: After he and his first wife separate, journalist David Sheff struggles to help their teenage son, who goes from experimenting with drugs to becoming devastatingly addicted to methamphetamine.
A true story of addiction, survival and family.
6505: Popular high schoolers and best friends Shawn and Nick decide to ditch football camp for cheerleader camp. For the girls and for the glory.
2 Guys. 300 Girls. You Do the Math.

7017: When her husband goes missing at the beach, a female professor begins to mentally disintegrate as her denial of his disappearance becomes delusional.
Can love vanish without a trace?

Phil DeVille / Lil DeVille / Betty DeVille (voice)

You'll Shriek At These Shieks! . . . trying the double - Oh! on Sheikess Dorothy Lamour!

After World War II, Hitler’s deadliest lieutenant escaped.

10857: A getaway driver for a bank robbery realizes he has been double crossed and races to find out who betrayed him.

Fantômas / Fandor / Lord Shelton / Vieux gardien de la prison

Finns det svenskt kaffe på grisfesten

What if you had the power to stop time?

He never wanted to be the hero

Pick a man. Seduce him. Trap him.

Never before a spectacle like the fall of the Roman empire

She's on the line... and off the wall.

Some meetings are more fatal than others.

Always give it your best even for a robbery.

He tamed the cattle... and the WILD natives of Hawaii.

18281: After the death of her handsome but good-for-nothing husband Vadinho, Flor, a widow, marries Dr. Teodoro, a respectable gentleman. Hilarity ensues when Vadinho's spirit returns into her life.
Dona Flor had two happy marriages. One was made in heaven.
18537: Improbable encounters bring tenderness, laughter and compassion to a world of urban alienation.

The master minds tackle the master crimes!
19817: A con man tries to blackmail a Mexican gangster.
THE EXCITEMENT OF DESPERATE ADVENTURE! THE SUSPENSE OF RELENTLESS MAN-HUNT!
20329: An ex-vaudeville actor is working as the assistant to a doctor who has Frankenstein aspirations. The ex-vaudeville actor kills the doctor and decides to assume the identity of the dead physician.
He menaced women with weird desires!

World War III begins on your toy shelf.

What happens when your first love is love itself?

First the relation between Antonio and the children is tough, but it relaxes so they become temporary friends.

Every holiday season, millions travel safely by air. This Christmas will be different.
23657: Enes Batur has to decide between going to college or being a professional YouTuber.
23913: A middle-class boy in Ahmedabad, Satyaprem falling in one-sided love with Katha, who is coping with her breakup with Tapan. Through the journey, they discover each other's life and complement in accomplishing what was left halfway.

Mahima is a doctor but Mahendra hasn't seen anyone play like her. Will the clash of dreams unite Mr. and Mrs. Mahi or create boundaries for life?

To stop a devil, you must summon a bigger one.

25705: A budding playwright and his wife attend a dinner party hosted by wealthy, cultural elites, who have promised to bankroll the writer's latest play to Broadway, but, in fact, have darker designs in mind for the couple.

What are we hiding in our thoughts?

They beam down. We rise up.

28009: When a family man suffers brain death, his extended family gathers around him as he is about to be taken off life support, and make plans to divide up his money.

Milind Gunaji's wife ( the Arabian princess)

At last! Their epic story invades the Big Screen!
29033: The story follows a young man (Bobby Deol) who flees India and arrives in Australia seeking vengence for something that started in India. The story keeps the covers on Bobby Deols plan until the end when everything is revealed as to why he is a SOLDIER.
He who kills for his country is called...Soldier

Don't accept fate, accept spring scenery.

In cyberspace no one can hear you scream.

Ari and her boyfriend, Navas, have hatched a plan to get around Mikel jewelry made ​​with his ex-girlfriend.

Exposing the Real Genocide of Nazi Germany

CinemaScope spectacularly spreads before you the velvet cape and violent age of Sir Walter Raleigh and The Virgin Queen.

Out of darkness she found hope to rise again
31849: A turbulent newsroom drama that intimately chronicles the working days of broadcast journalist Ravish Kumar as he navigates a spiraling world of truth and disinformation.

Will Fadil be able to save Gundhi and have his happy ending?

32617: Based on the book "Ich bin dann mal weg" by Hape Kerkeling where the author describes his journey on the Way of St. James, a pilgrimage route, and the people he encounters there.

34409: Marlon Cruz, a young Colombian man who motivated by his girlfriend Reina, leaves his comfortable life in Medellin and flees with her through Guatemala and Mexico, across the borders, illegally into the United States.

These are night faces... Living on the edge of evil and violence!

Fernando comes up with the idea to grow lavender and sell the oil to the perfume industry.
It's never too late to begin again.

Carefree Cary Grant on a gay holiday with his lovely bride walks right into DANGER!
36713: A Greek History Professor & his daughter travel to a Greek Island for one last chance to finish his thesis on ancient love spells before he loses his research grant. His daughter attempts to match her father with the local women without success until she meets a beautiful Mermaid with whose help the Professor might finally find true love for himself.
37225: A coming of age story set in 1975 working-class Brooklyn, in which two teenage brothers living with their abusive father and their well-meaning but ineffective mother are caught up in a life of petty crime. 37481: In the slum of Cité Soleil, President Aristide's most loyal supporters were ruling as kings. The five major gang leaders were controlling heavily armed young men; the Chiméres. 37737: Quinn Forte had it all: power, money, a brother who idolized him, and a woman who loved him. He also had enemies. In the course of one night, he loses everything. 38249: 3 childhood friends who have never left their hometown in the suburb try to get into porn as a way of earning easy money.
38505: Gervaise Macquart is a beautiful Parisian laundress and mother whose lover, Lantier, walks out on her. She eventually marries Henri Coupeau, a roofer who has an unfortunate accident. Gervaise Macquart Coupeau, une blanchisseuse douce et courageuse
Henri Coupeau - le second compagnon de Gervaise, un ouvrier zingueur
Mme Lorilleux - la soeur revêche de Coupeau
Virginie Poisson, une rivale de Gervaise
38761: Mathilukal ('Walls') is a free adaptation of the novelette of the same name, written by the celebrated Malayalam writer, Vaikom Muhammad Basheer. 39017: the film is about how a barber's life is turned upside down when a film unit comes to the village for a shoot, and the news spreads that superstar Ashok Raj (Mammootty) is the barber's childhood friend. 39273: Five teenage prodigies brutally beaten in New York’s Central Park plot an apocalyptic revenge against the world. Only master prodigy Jimbo Farrar knows their formidable power. But can he alone hold their rage at bay?
39529: Chasing their dream of landing their own hunting show, Jake and Stevie head to the dense, secluded mountains of West Virginia. Equipped with only their bow and camera, they have just three days to kill a monster buck big enough to grab the attention of the network...and they've found him. But the sun has set, and they realize they're not alone.
40041: A countess fleeing her husband mistakes a count for her hairdresser at a Monte Carlo casino.
As intimate as a lady's boudoir!
Count Rudolph Falliere / Rudy the Hairdresser
40297: A theatrical star, born on the wrong side of the tracks, marries a drunken blue-blood millionaire.

He finds interesting parallels in the life of the infamous bandit Plumitas when they eventually meet by chance.
You Haven't Seen Valentino Till You've Seen "Blood and Sand"

Things are looking up, until the wrong people hear portions of the historian's writing.
41833: Ram is falsely charged for killing his mother. His neigbours are also called for interrogation. Everyone's effort leads to tracking down the real killer.
42089: Deep in the Himalayas, a group of sherpas kills a gigantic humanoid creature. But what awaits them is something that none of them could have imagined. A colorful fusion of real image and stop-motion that is reminiscent of fantastic films from the 1980s.
A Civilization Lost in Time... Invaded One Million Years Ago
42345: Bobby leads a carefree life until his former lover arrives at his place with a baby girl claiming she is his daughter. However, Bobby must find the truth behind her claims.
An old relationship casts its threatening shadow on the present.
42601: When a corrupt cop gets embroiled in a heroic brawl, he has no idea how it would eventually lead him to a shocking rape case and change his life forever.

Fate dealt him the right card at the wrong time.

At the start of World War II, one man's courage would save a nation.

44137: When a free-spirited girl befriends a young teenager, they leave childhood behind to embrace a dangerous world of clubbing and sex with strange men.
There are times we need to try everything

The guilty always pay the price.
45417: A young married physician discovers a mermaid, and gives into her request to be taken to see London. Comedy and romantic entanglements ensue.
45673: A musical drama film directed by Ravi Jadhav, starring Riteish Deshmukh and Nargis Fakhri in the lead roles.
45929: After his younger sister is poisoned, a tough Ottawa cop embarks on a violent journey through Montreal to find her killer, which turns into a whirlpool of revenge and betrayal.
Enter at your own risk... for there is no such thing as a truly empty room
46185: A manifestation of lives of people coming from different classes and beliefs in a steamer as they set out for their journeys. Things start to get out of hand when the steamer gets stuck amidst the passage and deepest secrets and desires start to unfold.
46441: Bharat alias Bachchan is a kind-hearted real estate businessman, who is the MD of the Bharat Property Solutions. He is deeply in love with Anjali (Bhavana), who is doing MS in Bellary and wants to deliver honest service to the needy people. But her wish becomes an obstacle for a mining mafia don.
46697: On a college campus in modern America, ideas that have long been neglected as "issues of the past" emerge as racial tensions and frictions grow between different student groups.
46953: An idealistic policeman must bring down his estranged older brother, now a powerful gangster in a South Korean port city.

47721: A prototype of a  new cutting edge tank is being taken on a secret mission to Moscow, to Comrade Stalin. Soon the cross-country run turns into a ruthless race. Followed by Nazis, the tanks' team defeats their pursuers and proves the great ability and vast superiority of the machine that is about to become a legendary T-34.

Saving lives, solving two murders, upsetting a ring of forgers and falling in love - ll in a day's work for BULLDOG!
48233: The families of 18 soldiers who heroically died in 1944 are meeting at the place of the squad last battle.

One by one, they all fall down.

I don't mind, how about you?
Board Member of the Disciplinary Committee
Board Member of the Disciplinary Committee

All the 'signs' suggest her new lover will meet the same fate.
49769: Katerina, a poor girl, finds a job as a secretary and falls in love with her boss on a trip to Rome.

51049: Here and Elsewhere takes its name from the contrasting footage it shows of the fedayeen and of a French family watching television at home. Originally shot by the Dziga Vertov Group as a film on Palestinian freedom fighters, Godard later reworked the material alongside Anne-Marie Miéville.

The struggle between the two major gangs.

Every woman knows why the wrong man is irresistible!
